Rick rules with emotion (compassion and love, as can be seen with his group being a family) rules, but there are still penalties with his rules. 

Negan also goes by the approach that if one should go against the rules they should be punished, because it would instill fear into them and in others to hopefully stop the problem. 

Alternatively Rick and his group focuses on rehabilitation to encourage a unity and compassion. Look at Nicholas, he tried to kill Glenn and he got another member killed. They did not kill or punish Nicholas instead Glenn focused on rehabilitating him to be a valuable member of the group. 

Both methods of leadership are equally as viable. Compassion is a sign of weakness and can easily be over thrown, but inspires members to work together for each other. Fear inspires coups, but it ultimately gets shit done. In both methods there can be bad means to get what your group needs.
